items.raw_excerpt: The DGS has published, for the first time, national guidelines for nutrition in daycares and social care settings for children up to the age of three, recommending varied meals, age-appropriate portion sizes and textures, and reduced levels of ultra-processed foods, sugar, and salt.
items.summary_en: Portugal has released its first national guidelines for meals in daycares for children under three. The rules call for varied meals, age-appropriate portions, and less ultra-processed food, sugar, and salt.
items.summary_ko: 포르투갈 보건 당국이 만 3세 이하 어린이를 위한 어린이집의 첫 식사 가이드라인을 발표했습니다. 이 가이드라인은 다양한 식사와 연령에 맞는 양을 권장하고, 초가공식품과 설탕, 소금 섭취를 줄이도록 제안합니다.
items.title_en: Portugal sets new meal rules for daycares
items.title_ko: 포르투갈 어린이집 첫 식사 가이드라인 발표
items.title_original: DGS issues guidelines for meals in daycare centers in Portugal

items.raw_excerpt: After approval through a NASA and CSA selection process, the food company based in Gull Lake will be supplying jerky for the four-person mission with a launch date of Oct. 1.
items.summary_en: A food company in Gull Lake, Saskatchewan, was approved through NASA and CSA selection to supply bison jerky for a four-person mission. The jerky will travel to the International Space Station, with the mission set to launch on October 1.
items.summary_ko: 사스캐치원 주 굴레이크의 한 식품회사가 NASA와 CSA 선정 과정을 거쳐 4인 우주 임무용 들소 육포를 공급하게 되었다. 이 육포는 ISS에 실려 갈 예정이며, 임무는 10월 1일에 발사될 예정이다.
items.title_en: Astronaut chooses small-town Saskatchewan bison jerky to take to International Space Station

items.title_original: Astronaut chooses small-town Saskatchewan bison jerky to take to International Space Station

items.raw_excerpt: El trombonista Andrés Serrano recordó su paso por el grupo de cumbia.
items.summary_en: Andres Serrano, a trombone player, says a group once fired him for defending his friend. He was talking about Alexitico, a band he played with. The story is a small memory from his time in the group.
items.summary_ko: 트롬본 연주자 안드레스 세라노는 친구를 지켜준다고 죽를 다 났다며 한 그룹에서 해고당한 이야기를 떠올렸습니다. 그가 말하는 그룹은 알렉시티코로, 그가 함께 연주했던 팀입니다. 과거의 조별(group) 소{small}소로, 지금 진행 중인 이야기가 아닙니다.
items.title_en: A Cumbia Singer Says He Was Kicked Out of a Band for a Friend

items.summary_en: Mayo in Ireland once had many small railway lines that carried people and goods between towns. Most of these lines closed long ago. A local history group is now collecting old maps, photos, and stories to remember them.
items.summary_ko: 아일랜드 매요에는 마을과 도시를 연결하던 작은 철도 노선이 한때 많이 있었다. 대부분의 노선은 오래전에 폐쇄되었다. 지금은 지역 역사 모임이 옛 지도와 사진, 이야기를 모아 그 기억을 되살리고 있다.
items.title_en: The Lost Railway Lines of Mayo
items.title_original: Unique history of Mayo’s railway network from times past - con-telegraph.ie

items.raw_excerpt: The ÖVP in Vienna has called for longer Saturday opening hours and flexible Sunday opening at stores in the Austrian capital. As the debate over weekend closures in Austria continues, we look at whether change is on the horizon.
items.summary_en: The ÖVP party in Vienna wants shops to close later on Saturdays. It also asks for flexible Sunday opening hours. The debate about weekend closures in Austria is still going on.
items.summary_ko: 빈나의 오스트리아ículos 인민당(ÖVP)은 토요일에 가게 문을 더 늦게 닫아 달라고 주장했습니다. 일요일 영업 시간도 유연하게 바꾸자고 건의했습니다. 오스트리아 전체의 주말 휴점 논쟁은 아직 계속되고 있습니다.
items.title_en: Vienna shops push for later Saturday opening

items.title_original: Fresh push for Vienna shops to stay open later on Saturday

items.raw_excerpt: It was announced that over 35% of all wine produced in the Alentejo region is now certified under the Alentejo Regional Wine Commission (CVRA) sustainability program. This initiative has reached 30 regional producers.
items.summary_en: Over 35% of wine from Portugal's Alentejo region is now certified as sustainable under the CVRA program. This covers 30 local wine producers.
items.summary_ko: 포르투갈 알렌테주에서 생산되는 포도주의 35% 이상이 CVRA 지속가능 인증을 받았습니다. 이번 인증은 지역 내 30개 포도주 생산업체에 적용됩니다.
items.title_en: Alentejo wine region gets more sustainable certifications
items.title_original: More than 35% of the wine produced in Alentejo is certified sustainable
